categories.main_business_segments: IDACORP, Inc. operates primarily through its principal subsidiary, Idaho Power Company, which is a regulated electric utility. Other notable subsidiaries include IDACORP Financial Services, Inc. (IFS), which invests in affordable housing and real estate tax credit projects, and Ida-West Energy Company, which operates small hydropower generation projects. Nearly all of IDACORP's business is derived from Idaho Power's utility operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Idaho Power generates electricity using a diversified mix of hydropower, coal-fired, and natural gas-fired generation facilities, supplemented by long-term power purchase agreements and market purchases. The company operates 17 hydropower projects, co-owns coal and gas plants, and is increasingly integrating renewable energy sources and battery storage. Transmission and distribution are managed through an extensive network of substations and lines, with a focus on grid reliability and environmental compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are approximately 604,000 retail customers in southern Idaho and eastern Oregon, including residential, commercial, industrial, and irrigation users. Key end markets include food processing, electronics, manufacturing, agriculture, health care, government, and education. Wholesale energy sales and transmission services are also provided to utilities and power marketers.
categories.geographic_coverage: Idaho Power serves a 24,000 square mile area in southern Idaho and eastern Oregon, holding franchises in 72 Idaho cities and 7 Oregon cities, and certificates to serve portions of 25 Idaho counties and 3 Oregon counties. All operations are based in the United States, with headquarters in Boise, Idaho.
categories.supply_chain_position: Idaho Power operates as a vertically integrated utility, spanning upstream (generation), midstream (transmission), and downstream (distribution and retail sales) segments of the electricity supply chain. The company also participates in wholesale energy and transmission markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include growing financial strength, improving core utility operations, enhancing brand reputation, and maintaining employee safety and engagement. Idaho Power is focused on transitioning to 100% clean energy by 2045, expanding renewable and storage resources, exiting coal-fired generation, and investing in grid resiliency, wildfire mitigation, and environmental stewardship. R&D efforts are directed toward integrating renewables, battery storage, and advanced grid technologies.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through regulated sales of electricity to retail and wholesale customers, as well as transmission service fees. Retail rates are set on a cost-of-service basis, with additional revenue from power cost adjustment mechanisms, energy efficiency riders, and other regulatory programs. Transmission and wholesale revenues are based on FERC-approved tariffs and market-based rates.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Idaho Power operates as a natural monopoly within its service territory, facing limited direct competition for retail electric service. Indirect competition comes from alternative energy providers (e.g., natural gas, distributed solar), energy efficiency measures, and customer-owned generation. In wholesale and transmission markets, it competes with other regional utilities and power marketers, but maintains a strong position due to its regulated status and integrated operations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For 2021, IDACORP reported total operating revenues of $1.46 billion and net income attributable to IDACORP of $245.6 million, with a 2.8% annual customer growth rate and a 14th consecutive year of net income growth. The company has a strong balance sheet, with $2.0 billion in long-term debt and a capital structure of approximately 55% equity. Capital expenditures are expected to total up to $2.8 billion from 2022 to 2026, supporting continued infrastructure growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Idaho Power emphasizes reliable, affordable, and increasingly clean energy, leveraging its significant hydropower resources and a commitment to 100% clean energy by 2045. The company differentiates itself through operational excellence, customer service, environmental stewardship, and a proactive approach to grid modernization and climate adaptation. Its regulatory mechanisms and strong financial management provide stability and value to both customers and shareholders.
